locations.note: Operation Guillotine and the hunt for Al-Bashir in Tehran. The Grand Bazaar, Tehran Highway, Epicenter, Azadi Palace and Ziba Tower multiplayer maps are in the city.
Comrades: Dima races through Paris to stop the nuke, and fails. Operation Métro and Seine Crossing are multiplayer maps in the city.
The Great Destroyer: Blackburn is interrogated at Hunters Point in Queens, then hunts Solomon through the subway and the streets of Manhattan.
Operation Swordbreaker: Blackburn's Marines fight the PLR in Sulaymaniyah as an earthquake brings the city down.
Kaffarov: the raid on the arms dealer's villa in northern Iran. Operation Firestorm, Bandar Desert, Armored Shield and Operation Riverside are multiplayer maps in Iran's deserts and valleys.
Damavand Peak and Alborz Mountains: multiplayer maps on the slopes of the volcano, with a base-jump off the cliff.
Kharg Island: the oil terminal in the Gulf, a multiplayer map.
Noshahr Canals: the Caspian port's docks and canals, a multiplayer map.
Caspian Border: a forested border crossing by the Caspian, a multiplayer map.
Nebandan Flats: the desert outside the town, an End Game map.
Kiasar Railroad: the line through the forested hills, an End Game map.
Sabalan Pipeline: a snowbound pipeline on the volcano's flank, an End Game map.
Gulf of Oman: the Battlefield 2 beach, back in Back to Karkand.
Wake Island: the atoll returns in Back to Karkand.

routes.name: Sgt. Henry Blackburn
routes.note: Told from a CIA cell in Queens: a Marine's war from earthquake-struck Sulaymaniyah into Tehran and an arms dealer's villa in northern Iran, then a breakout to stop the bomb in Manhattan.

routes.name: Dimitri "Dima" Mayakovsky
routes.note: A Spetsnaz squad storms Kaffarov's villa in Iran, then races through Paris and fails to stop the nuke.
